name: Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion until soft, 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes with juice and chicken broth. Bring to a boil.
Use an immersion blender to blend until smooth.
Stir in heavy cream, basil, and sugar. Season with salt and pepper.
Simmer 5 more minutes. Serve with crusty bread.

substitutions.dairy_free: Replace heavy cream with full-fat coconut milk.
substitutions.gluten_free: Already gluten-free — just skip the bread.
substitutions.vegan: Use vegetable broth and coconut milk instead of chicken broth and cream.
substitutions.low_carb: Skip the sugar and bread, serve as-is.
